column7: A hand-painted 2D adventure game background, LucasArts 1995 era. Bold black contour lines around every shape, flat angular silhouettes, short palette of deep brown, black and hot amber, dramatic side lighting with hard terminator edges, rough paper texture, comic book proportions, no photographic realism, no smooth digital gradient. Subject: a man in a fedora and a long trench coat stands in a 1950s interrogation room at night, seen from behind, only the back of his hat and shoulders visible, no face, no profile. Three open folders spread in a fan on a wooden table, an empty chair, venetian blinds, a single low hanging lamp, cigarette smoke in the light beam.
